focus_areas: Fur texture realism vs. AI noise
Boundary integrity between subject and vegetation
Verification of 'Bare face' vs. fur-covered skin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mouth region; AI often struggles with open mouths or protruding tongues in animals, leading to fusion artifacts. Also, scrutinize the fur texture: real macro shots show individual hair strands, while AI often generates a 'carpet-like' or noisy texture. Verify if the 'ruff' is structurally connected to the head or if it floats. Crucially, use the detector's bbox to help the topology auditor separate the monkey from the grass, and ask the classifier to specifically look at the face texture to confirm if it is bare skin or just short fur.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a small monkey (Guenon) sitting in tall green grass. The monkey has dark grey/black fur with a lighter grey/white ruff around the face and throat. It is looking down and to the right, with its tongue slightly protruding. The background consists of out-of-focus green vegetation.
